task: AdEMAMix convergence speed against AdamW and momentum on a fixed synthetic task

paper.title: AdEMAMix: A Smarter Learning Rate Schedule for Adam
paper.authors: Matteo Pagliardini, Pierre Ablin, David Grangier

hypothesis: AdEMAMix's slow EMA, mixed in with a growing coefficient, should reach a training-loss target in fewer epochs than AdamW at a matched budget. Each arm - including the warmup length that only AdEMAMix has - is tuned by the same rule used for the earlier optimizer suite: lowest final training loss inside the grid, ties to the smaller value.
